$comment: The library catalogue: every skill with its category, plugin (core or games) and manual (side-effecting run-* runbook) flag, plus a one-line summary. tools/build-catalog.mjs and the index skill (build-index.mjs --catalog) read it; never edit the files they generate.

skills.name: react-native-conventions-index
skills.oneLine: The front door: house rules, a generated task-to-skills table, build orders for a new app and a new feature, how to load skills and report.

skills.name: tdd-workflow
skills.oneLine: Red-green-refactor for RN/Expo: test names, layer order, the evidence each change needs, never editing a test to pass.

skills.name: quality-gates
skills.oneLine: check:fast and verify scripts, git hooks (lefthook), Claude Code hooks, the guardrail, and fixing a failing gate without weakening it.

skills.name: git-commits-and-reporting
skills.oneLine: Conventional Commits with trailers (Gate-Change), release tags, the plain-language change report with evidence, stop-and-ask messages.

skills.name: spec-traceability
skills.oneLine: Requirement IDs in a spec file, quoted by the first failing test, referenced in commits and reports, with a checker that finds untraced or dangling IDs.

skills.name: troubleshooting-playbook
skills.oneLine: A catalogue of known RN/Expo/Xcode/Gradle/Jest/Metro failures with causes and fixes, a symptom lookup, and a pitfall scanner.

skills.name: skill-maintenance
skills.oneLine: Writing and changing agent skills to this standard: scaffold, descriptions that route, self-tested checkers, validation and routing evals.

skills.name: expo-project-bootstrap
skills.oneLine: Create a new Expo app from empty with the canonical stack, every config file, scripts and gates proven green; monorepo variant fenced.

skills.name: architecture-and-boundaries
skills.oneLine: Where code goes: the src/ layout, dependency zones checked by a script, ports and adapters for every side effect, the composition root.

skills.name: typescript-and-lint-rules
skills.oneLine: The strict tsconfig set, the ESLint flat config, size and complexity limits, forbidden patterns, TSDoc, and how to split code that grows.

skills.name: naming-conventions
skills.oneLine: Names of files, identifiers, hooks, handlers, routes, testIDs, message keys, scripts, env vars and packages.

skills.name: dependency-management
skills.oneLine: Adding, upgrading and removing packages: npx expo install, exact pins, release-age policy, install scripts, licence audit, expo-doctor.

skills.name: expo-sdk-upgrade
skills.oneLine: A runbook to move to the next Expo SDK (and Xcode/Android toolchain) safely: triggers, breaking changes, re-verification.

skills.name: expo-prebuild-and-config-plugins
skills.oneLine: Continuous Native Generation: app.config.ts as the single source, config plugins (local ones tested), never editing ios/android by hand, when to leave prebuild.

skills.name: app-variants-and-environment
skills.oneLine: APP_VARIANT development/preview/production: ids, names and icons per variant, EXPO_PUBLIC_* is public, secrets only in EAS/CI, test-only code stripped from store builds.

skills.name: scaffold-feature-screen
skills.oneLine: Stand up one feature: Expo Router route, pure screen view, model hook, components, tests, message keys and typed params, proven complete by a script.

skills.name: react-components-and-hooks
skills.oneLine: React rules for components and hooks: props, model hooks, effects only for outside systems, React Compiler, selectors, Pressable, lists, safe areas, error boundaries.

skills.name: design-system-structure
skills.oneLine: Token-agnostic design system: two-tier tokens, light/dark sets, ThemeProvider and makeStyles, AppText type roles, motion tokens, a no-raw-values checker.

skills.name: ui-component-library
skills.oneLine: Shared UI components: anatomy, sizes from tokens, every state, accessibility, a required testID with derived part ids, and tests for each.

skills.name: screen-contracts
skills.oneLine: A screen contract per screen (layout, components, testIDs, copy keys, states) in contracts/screens.json, and a checker that proves built screens match it.

skills.name: ui-states-and-feedback
skills.oneLine: The non-happy paths: loading, empty, filtered-empty, error with retry and offline states, delayed skeletons, toast/banner/dialog ladder, Undo over confirm.

skills.name: forms-and-input
skills.oneLine: Forms with react-hook-form and valibot: field components, sync and async validation, focus chain, keyboard handling, autofill hints, error text from message keys.

skills.name: adaptive-layout
skills.oneLine: Layouts that adapt by window size, not device: size classes, two-pane list-detail, readable widths, insets, orientation, tablets and foldables.

skills.name: motion-and-animation
skills.oneLine: Motion with Reanimated 4: a declared moment catalog, motion tokens, interruptible animations, reduce motion everywhere, bounded celebration.

skills.name: audio-and-haptics-feedback
skills.oneLine: Sound effects and haptics: a cue table, when each plays, throttling, respecting silent mode and the user setting, synthesized sounds, testing.

skills.name: icons-app-icon-and-splash
skills.oneLine: Icons, app icon and splash drawn in code: an icon set as paths, rasterized assets for iOS and Android adaptive icons, splash config, store art.

skills.name: skia-canvas-rendering
skills.oneLine: Drawing with Skia: a layout model, pictures and timelines, a frame clock, shared values, text on canvas, lifecycle, and pixel goldens.

skills.name: canvas-gestures-and-hit-testing
skills.oneLine: Taps, swipes, drags and aim on a canvas turned into typed commands, with hit-testing that shares the renderer layout.

skills.name: design-visual-parity
skills.oneLine: Proves each built screen matches its approved design screenshot in light/dark and LTR/RTL, with a capture, compare and sign-off loop.

skills.name: design-review-workflow
skills.oneLine: An end-of-build design and QA sweep: every screen x theme x direction x text size x reduce motion x device, graded findings, a dated sign-off.

skills.name: navigation-and-routing
skills.oneLine: Expo Router: file routes, layouts, typed routes and params, protected groups, modals, back handling, not-found; React Navigation 7 static as an appendix.

skills.name: deep-links-and-universal-links
skills.oneLine: Custom schemes, iOS universal links (AASA) and Android app links (assetlinks), routing incoming links, untrusted params, cold vs warm start, tests.

skills.name: app-startup-and-bootstrap
skills.oneLine: The root startup order: polyfills, error net, config, storage open and hydrate, i18n, theme, providers, routes; splash held until ready; flush on background.

skills.name: settings-and-preferences
skills.oneLine: One settings model: saved fields, the settings screen rows, the effect of each setting, persistence, and resets that never touch settings.

skills.name: state-management-zustand
skills.oneLine: Client state with Zustand 5: one store per domain, pure reducers, selectors and useShallow, persist-before-publish, and the server-state split.

skills.name: networking-and-server-state
skills.oneLine: Server state with TanStack Query over a typed ApiClient port: validated responses, query keys, retries, cancellation, optimistic updates, online/focus managers, offline.

skills.name: auth-and-secure-storage
skills.oneLine: Sign-in and sessions: tokens in expo-secure-store, single-flight refresh, protected route groups, OAuth with PKCE, Sign in with Apple, logout that clears everything.

skills.name: persistence-and-migrations
skills.oneLine: Local data on expo-sqlite through a SqlDriver port: tables and repositories, transactions, WAL, forward-only migrations tested on node:sqlite, backups, kill test.

skills.name: run-migration
skills.oneLine: The ritual for shipping a schema migration: snapshot first, bump by one, append-only steps, every from-to path tested, forced-failure restore.

skills.name: data-export-and-restore
skills.oneLine: Portable data: a versioned, checksummed backup envelope, all-or-nothing restore, safe CSV, share and pick files behind a port, round-trip tests.

skills.name: error-handling-typed-results
skills.oneLine: A Result/failure spine: errors converted at boundaries, exhaustive handling, failure codes mapped to messages, a global error net, never losing user data.

skills.name: async-safety
skills.oneLine: No silent async failure: no floating promises, synchronous handlers, effect races and stale responses cancelled, listeners and timers cleaned up.

skills.name: dates-streaks-and-statistics
skills.oneLine: Calendar-day logic: local date keys, an injected clock, DST and time zones, streak rules, and statistics summaries, all pure and tested.

skills.name: value-objects-money-and-units
skills.oneLine: Values stored canonically: integer minor units with ISO-4217 exponents, units and UTC instants, formatting only at the edge, allocation without lost cents.

skills.name: seeded-determinism-and-golden-vectors
skills.oneLine: Output every device must compute identically: one seeded PRNG, civil-date keys, regenerate-not-store, versioned cutovers, golden vectors from an independent oracle.

skills.name: i18n-strings-and-catalogs
skills.oneLine: Every visible string through react-intl catalogs: semantic keys, ICU plurals, Intl polyfills, catalog parity checks, translation workflow.

skills.name: rtl-and-direction
skills.oneLine: Right-to-left layout: logical styles, direction switch and reload, mirroring rules, digits, bidi isolation, testing RTL on iOS and Android.

skills.name: accessibility-as-code
skills.oneLine: Accessibility as a checked property: roles and names, 44pt targets, text scaling to 200%, contrast, reduce motion, VoiceOver and TalkBack checks.

skills.name: performance-budgets
skills.oneLine: Measured budgets for cold start, frames, lists, storage writes, bundle size and memory on iOS and Android, and how to measure each.

skills.name: local-notifications
skills.oneLine: On-device reminders with expo-notifications: the database as source of truth, one idempotent sync, DST-safe schedules, iOS 64 cap, Android channels.

skills.name: push-notifications
skills.oneLine: Remote push with expo-notifications: permission in context, token lifecycle and server contract, channels, taps mapped to typed screens (never URLs), foreground handling, testing.

skills.name: permissions-and-system-prompts
skills.oneLine: Asking for OS permissions from the press, with an explain sheet, denied vs blocked handling, the Settings hand-off, translated purpose strings and Android runtime rules (ATT: admob-ads-and-consent).

skills.name: media-images-and-files
skills.oneLine: Images and files: expo-image with sizing and caching, picking and capturing media, the file system, sharing, memory and permission rules.

skills.name: background-tasks
skills.oneLine: Work outside the foreground: expo-background-task and task manager, OS limits on iOS and Android, idempotent short jobs, testing.

skills.name: native-modules-and-new-architecture
skills.oneLine: Native code on the New Architecture: a local Expo module behind a port, Turbo Modules and codegen, checking library compatibility, testing.

skills.name: web-support
skills.oneLine: Running the app on the web with react-native-web: platform files, modules that are missing on web, layout and input differences, testing.

skills.name: admob-ads-and-consent
skills.oneLine: AdMob banners, interstitials and rewarded ads behind a port, UMP consent then ATT, ad pacing policy, test ids, and store declarations.

skills.name: in-app-purchases
skills.oneLine: In-app purchases with expo-iap behind a port: a Premium entitlement, every purchase state, restore, refunds and revocation, StoreKit and Play testing.

skills.name: privacy-and-store-declarations
skills.oneLine: Privacy proof: network only through the API port (or offline-only), SDK inventory, iOS privacy manifest, App Privacy and Data safety answers, secrets.

skills.name: crash-reporting-and-observability
skills.oneLine: Crash reporting with Sentry behind a port: source maps and symbols per build, release and dist naming, PII scrubbing, consent, breadcrumbs.

skills.name: analytics-and-consent
skills.oneLine: Product analytics behind a port: a typed event schema, consent before any SDK starts, ATT, and store declarations that match what is collected.

skills.name: unit-and-component-tests
skills.oneLine: Jest with jest-expo and RNTL 14: projects, renderWithProviders, root mocks, async queries by role, fast-check properties, coverage and mutation testing.

skills.name: golden-and-snapshot-tests
skills.oneLine: Data and pixel goldens that change only on purpose: where they live, tolerances, the -u policy, the Gate-Change trailer, no component-tree snapshots.

skills.name: run-goldens-rebaseline
skills.oneLine: The only sanctioned way to overwrite goldens: real assertions green first, one file at a time, every diff inspected, orphans deleted, proven without the flag.

skills.name: e2e-maestro
skills.oneLine: End-to-end flows with Maestro on iOS simulators and Android emulators: testIDs, state setup by deep link, offline simulation, the screenshot matrix.

skills.name: debug-menu-and-test-hooks
skills.oneLine: Test-only code that never ships: a test-build gate, a debug deep-link registry, simulated clock and connectivity, and a check that store builds strip it all.

skills.name: ios-simulator-build
skills.oneLine: Release builds on the iOS simulator: prebuild, xcodebuild, install, launch and screenshot, per variant, with the toolchain pinned and the device named.

skills.name: android-emulator-build
skills.oneLine: Release builds on the Android emulator: prebuild, Gradle, install, launch and screenshot, per variant, with the JDK/SDK pinned and the device named.

skills.name: eas-build-and-submit
skills.oneLine: EAS Build and Submit: eas.json profiles, credentials, remote versions, fingerprints, submitting to TestFlight and Play internal testing with gates first.

skills.name: ios-release-testflight
skills.oneLine: Shipping iOS: signing, archive, export, validate and upload to TestFlight (EAS or the local lane), build numbers, the store-artifact gate, human steps.

skills.name: android-release-play
skills.oneLine: Shipping Android: upload key and Play App Signing, AAB, versionCode, tracks and staged rollout, Data safety, target SDK and 16 KB pages, the artifact gate.

skills.name: ota-updates
skills.oneLine: Over-the-air updates with expo-updates and EAS Update: runtime versions from fingerprints, channels, staged rollout and rollback, never shipping native changes OTA.

skills.name: ci-pipeline-and-gates
skills.oneLine: CI on GitHub Actions: pinned toolchain, caches, the same gates as local verify, Android and iOS jobs, E2E lanes, secrets and concurrency.

skills.name: game-rules-engine
skills.oneLine: A game's rules as a pure deterministic engine behind a game contract: state, moves, events, seeded randomness, property tests.

skills.name: level-generation-and-solvers
skills.oneLine: Generated levels proven solvable by a solver: par, stars, packs, difficulty metrics, and the daily level from a date seed.

skills.name: game-session-host
skills.oneLine: Hosting a game in an app: the game screen, pause and resume, undo and hints, results, save points and progress.

skills.name: game-balance-and-bots
skills.oneLine: Headless bots and simulations: difficulty curves, balance bands, tuning constants, and a fun-within-seconds test.

skills.name: realtime-game-loop
skills.oneLine: Real-time play: a fixed-step loop on the UI thread, simulate-then-replay phases, recorded inputs and replay tests.

skills.name: new-game-scaffold
skills.oneLine: Start a new game from a script with its declaration and catalog keys (or a white-label app), proven complete at the end.
